mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 session_id FROM erp_bookstore_clinic_session WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND session_date = #{date} AND status = 'ENTERED' ORDER BY session_id DESC
mapper.sql:
SELECT cs.session_id AS sessionId, cs.student_id AS studentId, st.student_name AS studentName, cs.status AS sessionStatus, cs.session_date AS sessionDate, cs.entered_at AS enteredAt, cs.exited_at AS exitedAt, cs.quiz_started_at AS quizStartedAt,
rl.recommend_id AS recommendId, rl.content_id AS contentId, c.original_title AS bookTitle, c.author AS author, c.publisher AS publisher, c.image_url AS imageUrl, c.reading_time AS readingTimeText, rl.recommended_at AS recommendedAt, rl.correct_count AS basicCorrectCount, rl.total_count AS basicTotalCount, rl.status AS basicStatus, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, rl.recommended_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS elapsedMinutes,
adv.correctCount AS advancedCorrectCount, adv.totalCount AS advancedTotalCount,
badge.badgeCount AS badgeCount, badge.latestBadgeName AS latestBadgeName,
rlog.log_id AS readingLogId, rlog.attitude_codes AS attitudeCodes, rlog.help_needed AS helpNeeded, rlog.note AS note FROM erp_bookstore_clinic_session cs JOIN erp_student st ON st.student_id = cs.student_id OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 recommend_id, content_id, recommended_at, correct_count, total_count, status FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log WHERE student_id = cs.student_id ORDER BY recommend_id DESC ) rl LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content c ON c.content_id = rl.content_id OUTER APPLY ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN q.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correctCount FROM erp_bookstore_quiz_answer_log q WHERE q.recommend_id = rl.recommend_id AND q.qlevel = '02' AND q.submitted_at = ( SELECT MAX(q2.submitted_at) FROM erp_bookstore_quiz_answer_log q2 WHERE q2.recommend_id = rl.recommend_id AND q2.qlevel = '02' ) ) adv OUTER APPLY ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS badgeCount, (SELECT TOP 1 b.badge_name FROM erp_bookstore_student_badge sb2 JOIN erp_bookstore_badge b ON b.badge_id = sb2.badge_id WHERE sb2.student_id = cs.student_id ORDER BY sb2.earned_at DESC) AS latestBadgeName FROM erp_bookstore_student_badge sb WHERE sb.student_id = cs.student_id ) badge LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_reading_log rlog ON rlog.session_id = cs.session_id
mapper.select: WHERE cs.session_date = #{date} ORDER BY cs.entered_at ASC
mapper.update: MERGE erp_bookstore_reading_log AS target USING (SELECT #{sessionId} AS session_id) AS source ON target.session_id = source.session_id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET attitude_codes = #{attitudeCodes}, help_needed = #{helpNeeded}, note = #{note}, created_by = #{createdBy}, updated_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (session_id, student_id, attitude_codes, help_needed, note, created_by) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{studentId}, #{attitudeCodes}, #{helpNeeded}, #{note}, #{createdBy});
